questions.prompt: Which tool is the right first choice for finding a one-past-the-end write on a heap array?
questions.explanation: ASan instruments memory accesses and reports heap-buffer-overflow with the faulty line.

questions.prompt: An ASan report says '0 bytes to the right of 64-byte region' for an array of doubles. What is the index of the element that was accessed (zero-based)? Give an integer.
questions.explanation: 64 bytes / 8 bytes per double = 8 elements (indices 0-7); an access 0 bytes right of the region is index 8.

questions.prompt: A buggy program prints slightly wrong numbers but never crashes. What is the most likely explanation?
options: Undefined behavior: the invalid read returned some value without a fault
The sanitizer is required for the program to run correctly
questions.explanation: UB gives no guarantee, including no guarantee of a crash. Tests must check values.

questions.prompt: A regression was introduced somewhere in 600 commits. What is the maximum number of builds git bisect needs? Give an integer.
Which is the best property of a regression test?
options: It computes the expected value by calling the function under test
It passes on both the buggy and the fixed code
It fails on the buggy code and passes on the fixed code
It prints the result so a human can check it
questions.explanation: A test that never failed proves nothing; the expected value must be independent of the code under test.

questions.prompt: A flaky test fails with probability 0.05 per run. What is the smallest number of runs that gives at least 90% chance of seeing one failure? Give an integer.
Outline the steps you would take for a robot node that crashes once an hour with a segmentation fault, from first report to a merged fix. Name the tools.
rubric: Makes it reproducible/reduced: record the input (rosbag or log), run in a loop, shrink the input.
Locates it with a core dump and GDB bt, and with ASan/UBSan (or TSan for races) builds.
Writes a regression test that fails before the fix, fixes, re-runs under sanitizers in CI.
questions.explanation: Rubric-guided: compare your answer with each rubric point; this question is not automatically graded.
